output.rationale: The goods are described as 'Green coffee beans... not roasted', which falls directly under the text of heading 09.01 ('Coffee, whether or not roasted or decaffeinated'). Chapter 21 Note 1(b) explicitly excludes roasted coffee substitutes from Chapter 21, reinforcing that coffee products remain in Chapter 9, and no note excludes unroasted coffee beans from heading 09.01.
